import nki
import nki.language as nl
import nki.isa as nisa

@nki.jit
def tensor_avgpool_kernel(x, pool_size):
    C, H, W = x.shape
    p = pool_size
    out_H = H // p
    out_W = W // p
    # Ensure input is a multiple of pool_size
    assert H % p == 0 and W % p == 0, "Input dimensions must be multiples of pool_size"
    
    # Create a view with shape (C, out_H, out_W, p, p)
    view = nl.ndarray(shape=(C, out_H, out_W, p, p), dtype=x.dtype, layout=nl.Layout.NHWC)
    # Copy input into the view
    nisa.dma_copy(view, x)
    
    # Compute sum over the last two axes
    sum_view = nl.sum(view, axis=[3, 4])
    
    # Normalize by p*p
    norm = nisa.tensor_scalar(1.0 / (p * p), dtype=x.dtype)
    result = nl.broadcast_mul(sum_view, norm)
    
    # Return the result with shape (C, out_H, out_W)
    return result.reshape((C, out_H, out_W))
